scope: Rendered Windows Player, full notebook scene with ordinary HUD and input enabled, automatic replay commands. VSync off, target60. Frame delta includes pacing and is aligned to prior frame work. Profiler recorders sampled for preceding completed frame. Startup/scenario construction and final report serialization excluded. No screenshots during measurement. Do not send manual commands during replay; compare state fingerprint with headless replay.

configuration.Rules: Default finite health, damage, reload, construction and material rules. Scenario tuning sets map, starting budget, enemy mix/speeds and spawn interval; passive supply, early-launch income and wave grants are zero. No direct entity mutation. At tick 0 buy a closed Marker wall ring. After 150 fixed steps launch. After the first naturally destroyed outer wall, buy 48 inner Marker weapons: three mortars then one piercer, repeated. No further commands or injected bonuses.
